name: Scott Foley
bio: Scott Kellerman Foley (born July 15, 1972) is an American actor and director. He is best known for his TV roles as Nick Blackburn on The Big Leap, Will Chase on Whiskey Cavalier, Henry Goodwin on the sitcom The Goodwin Games, Jake Ballard on Scandal, Patrick Devins on True Blood, Bob Brown on The Unit, Adam Sullivan on A.U.S.A., Sean Kelly on Scrubs, Noel Crane on Felicity, and a recurring role as Henry Burton on Grey's Anatomy. He wrote, produced, and directed the film Let's Kill Ward's Wife (2014).
